title: 'Summary' divider precedes the financial summary
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can generate an Estimate or Invoice.
steps:
1. Generate the document.
2. Find where the work section ends and the financial summary begins.
expected:
1. A divider labeled exactly "Summary" precedes the financial summary.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9146 (Story 7, Financial Summary) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 45, section S7-R1, read on 31 August 2026.

title: Summary shows gross Labor and Parts rows, and Shop supplies when charged
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. A document exists with labor charges, parts charges, and a shop-supplies charge.
steps:
1. Generate the document.
2. Read the financial summary rows for Labor, Parts and Shop supplies.
expected:
1. The summary shows a row labeled exactly "Labor" and a row labeled exactly "Parts".
2. Each shows the gross amount - before any fees or discounts.
3. A row labeled exactly "Shop supplies" shows only when a shop-supplies charge applies.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9146 (Story 7, Financial Summary) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 45, sections S7-R2 and S7-R6, read on 31 August 2026.

title: Shop supplies shows its percentage when the location setting is enabled
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can reach a document whose location has "Show % on Estimates and Invoices" enabled and shop supplies charged as a percentage of labor, and one with the setting disabled.
steps:
1. Generate a document with the setting enabled and read the Shop supplies row.
2. Generate one with the setting disabled and read the Shop supplies row.
expected:
1. When the location's "Show % on Estimates and Invoices" setting is enabled and shop supplies are charged as a percentage of labor, the percentage is shown alongside the shop supplies amount.
2. Otherwise the shop supplies amount is shown alone.

---

title: Adjustments group shows rollup Labor/Parts then each work-order-wide row
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. A document exists with line-level labor and parts fees/discounts and two or more work-order-wide adjustments added in a known order.
steps:
1. Generate the document.
2. Read the Adjustments group in the financial summary, top to bottom.
expected:
1. Fees and discounts are grouped under a heading labeled exactly "Adjustments", which carries no amount of its own.
2. Under it, in this order: a rollup row labeled "Labor" totaling all line-level labor fees and discounts, a rollup row labeled "Parts" totaling all line-level parts fees and discounts, then each work-order-wide fee or discount as its own named row in the order it was added.
3. A "Labor" or "Parts" rollup row shows only when its total is not zero; a negative rollup shows in parentheses, a positive rollup as a plain amount.
4. A work-order-wide discount shows in parentheses; a work-order-wide fee shows as a plain amount.
5. There are intentionally two "Labor" rows and two "Parts" rows in the summary; the Adjustments pair is distinguished by sitting under the Adjustments heading.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9146 (Story 7, Financial Summary) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 45, sections S7-R4 and S7-R5, read on 31 August 2026.

title: Summary shows Subtotal, one row per tax, and the grand Total
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. A document exists with one or more applicable taxes.
steps:
1. Generate the document.
2. Read the Subtotal, tax rows, and Total in the summary.
expected:
1. The summary shows a row labeled exactly "Subtotal".
2. It shows one tax row per applicable tax, each labeled with the tax name and its rate.
3. It shows the grand total labeled exactly "Total".
4. Every row that contributes to the Subtotal is displayed; no contributing summary row is hidden.
5. The visible math holds: gross Labor + gross Parts + Shop supplies + all Adjustments rows = Subtotal.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9146 (Story 7, Financial Summary) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 45, sections S7-R7, S7-R8, S7-R9 and S7-R10, read on 31 August 2026.

title: Adjustments heading and tax rows hide when nothing applies
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can reach a document with no work-order-wide adjustments and both rollup totals zero, and one with no applicable tax.
steps:
1. Generate a document with no adjustments and zero rollups; look for the Adjustments heading.
2. Generate a document with no applicable tax; look for a tax row.
expected:
1. The Adjustments heading is not shown when there is nothing to list under it (no work-order-wide fees or discounts and both rollup totals at zero).
2. When no tax applies, no tax row is shown.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9146 (Story 7, Financial Summary) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 45, sections S7-N1 and S7-N2, read on 31 August 2026.
